label: nativecrop193
removal_policy: All fin components start at the bed. Wide portal panels route around intervening body material using independently checked 45-degree layer growth; they never rely on the body for their roots. Sever yellow teeth, cut the orange portal crown into separate sections, then remove the legs, buttresses and base joins. This is a cut-apart support frame, not a guaranteed single-direction extraction. Empty assembly clearances must be fully cleaned before assembly.

portal_layer_growth.method: Every fin-only cross-section, without any body material as backing, must grow by no more than one layer height in XY plus 0.015 mm geometric tolerance. Every material island must overlap the preceding fin slice. All physical fin components separately must start at the bed. Ordinary portal panels are at least 3.2 mm thick. A specifically designated 2.4 mm panel requires two transverse buttresses at least 14 mm deep and every bed leg at least max(12 mm, height/5) wide. A compact passage fin may be 1.6 mm thick only below 12 mm height with a bed leg at least 4 mm wide. Fin-only growth and bed connectivity remain mandatory; this dimensional screen is not a strength simulation.
